journey.name: Subscription Refunds
journey.description: Validates that an administrator can review subscription refunds, see where each stands, ask the provider for the current state of one that is still open, and read how much time was taken back from the merchant.

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/billing/plans', then click 'Refunds'.
Verify refunds are listed newest first with merchant link, amount, status badge, reason and the time-taken-back result.
Verify a PENDING refund shows a 'Refresh' button and a FAILED refund shows the provider message and no button.
Click 'Refresh' on the pending refund and verify the row updates from the response (for example to PROCESSED with the days removed).
Open '/dashboard/billing/operations' for a merchant with refund activity and verify Recent billing events read 'Refund requested', 'Refund status changed' and 'Refunded time taken off subscription'.
